blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Political discourse is widely perceived to be growing more hostile, yet robust evidence remains scarce. This study examines blame attribution in the Danish Parliament from 1997 to 2026, combining a purpose-built classifier, BlameBERT ( F1: 0.80), with multilevel statistical modeling. The classifier is constructed using an annotation-efficient pipeline for blame attribution in low-to-mid resource languages. The results reveal a banana-shaped trajectory, with blame declining until around 2016 before entering a significant and sustained increase in recent years (2019–2026). Government status consistently influenced blame attribution – an effect we term political contrasting -- with opposition parties blaming substantially more than governing parties. This effect was moderated by ideology: The blame-dampening effect of governing was less pronounced among right-wing parties, and ideological extremity amplified blame more strongly on the right. In recent years, the interaction between political wing and ideological extremity intensified, suggesting an ideological hardening of the blame rhetoric concentrated on the right of the political spectrum. Taken together, these patterns suggest that the perceived rise in harsh political language reflects not merely a general rhetorical drift but an ideologically asymmetric hardening of political discourse.
A sensitivity analysis showed that the conclusions were robust to varying classification thresholds. 1 1 1 Code is publicly available on GitHub https://github.com/Lundsfryd/BlameBERT and the model and dataset are available on Hugging Face https://huggingface.co/Lundsfryd/BlameBERT and https://huggingface.co/datasets/runetrust/blame-folketinget-dk
blocks.zh:
人们普遍认为,政治言论越来越充满敌意,但有力的证据仍然很少。 这项研究研究了1997年至2026年丹麦议会的责任归属问题,将专门设计的分类器BlameBERT(F1:0.80)与多层次统计模型相结合。 分类器的构造使用高效的注解管道,用于低至中度资源语言的责难归属. 结果揭示出香蕉状的轨迹,被指责到2016年左右才进入近年来(2019–2026年)显著而持续的增长. 政府地位一直影响责任归属(我们称之为政治对比效应),而反对党的指责远远大于执政党。 这种效果被意识形态所缓和: 右翼政党对治理的责难掩盖作用不太明显,意识形态极端化使右翼受到更强烈的指责。 近年来,政治派别和意识形态极端之间的相互作用有所加强,这表明在意识形态上强化了集中在政治派别右边的指责言论。 总而言之,这些模式表明,人们所认为的严酷政治语言的上升不仅反映了一般的花言巧语,而且反映了政治言论在意识形态上不对称地硬化。
一项敏感性分析显示,这些结论对不同的分类阈值是强有力的。 1 1 代码可在GitHub https://github.com/Lundsfryd/BlameBERT上公开查阅. 并可在Hugging Face https://huggingface.co/Lundsfryd/BlameBERT上查阅模型和数据集。 和https://huggingface.co/datasets/runetrust/blame-folketinget-dk 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Discourse in the media, and society at large, has been concerned with communication within politics taking a turn toward sharper tones ( Bilotta et al., 2025 ; Frisch and Kelly, 2013 ; Montanaro, 2018 ; Shandwick and Tate, 2019 ; Frisch, 2022 ) . This perceived shift toward more hostile communication Bøggild and Jensen (2025) ; Muddiman (2017) ; Theocharis et al. (2020) ; Van’t Riet and Van Stekelenburg (2022) , is disputed both internationally and specifically in Danish settings Barton (2023) ; Brusgaard (2022) ; Kenski and Jamieson (2017) ; Shandwick and Tate (2019) . Much of the empirical evidence comes from social media Stie (2021) ; Frisch (2022) ; Becker (2021) ; Hansen (2024) . Parliamentary discourse, by contrast, remains comparatively underexamined, despite arguably carrying greater institutional weight. Parliamentary proceedings offer a unique window into policy positions and rhetorical strategies ( Proksch and Slapin, 2014 ) , where blame attribution plays a pivotal role, as political actors routinely assign responsibility and criticize opponents to shape public perception and influence debates Hinterleitner (2020) ; Heinkelmann-Wild and Zangl (2020) .
blocks.zh: 媒体及全社会关注政治内部的沟通, 在丹麦巴顿(2023年)、布鲁斯加尔德(2022年)、肯斯基和杰米森(2017年)、尚德威克和塔特(2019年), 经验证据大多出自社交媒体"Stie" (2021);"Frisch" (2022);"Becker" (2021);"Hansen" (2024). 相比之下,议会的议论相对来说仍然没有得到充分的审查,尽管可以说具有更大的机构影响力。 议会程序为政策立场和花言巧语战略提供了一个独特的窗口(Proksch和Slapin,2014年),其中指责归属起着关键作用,因为政治行为体通常会分配责任并批评反对者塑造公众观念并影响辩论。

blocks.en: Analyzing blame dynamics requires close attention to the evaluative tone of discourse, as expressions of disapproval and criticism are key indicators of how responsibility is constructed and communicated Chilton (2004) ; Powell Jr (2004) . Emotional language is not merely rhetorical embellishment but a fundamental component of political communication, contributing to processes such as affective polarization, and, potentially, the stability of democratic systems Garrett et al. (2014) ; Mason (2015) ; Young and Soroka (2012) ; Bøggild and Jensen (2025) .
blocks.zh: 分析责任动态需要密切关注讨论的评价基调,因为表示不赞同和批评是形成和传达责任的关键指标;小鲍威尔(2004年)。 情感语言不仅仅是夸夸其谈的装饰,而是政治沟通的一个基本组成部分,促进了情感两极分化等进程,并有可能促进了民主制度的稳定。

blocks.en: 1.1 Blame and Political Communication
blocks.zh: 1.1 指责和政治宣传

blocks.en: Blame is inherently evaluative, as it combines causal attribution with negative sentiment, distinguishing it from mere criticism or disagreement ( Bilotta et al., 2025 ) . This duality is theoretically grounded in moral psychology, where blame functions as a signal that the blaming party adheres to norms which the blamed party violates ( Shoemaker and Vargas, 2021a ) . In political contexts, this norm-signaling logic generates a clear prediction, where actors in opposition, who position themselves against a governing party, have the strongest incentive to blame, as doing so simultaneously highlights their opponents’ policy failures and differentiates their own position. We refer to this as political contrasting , a rhetorical strategy in which opposition parties systematically blame more than governing parties ( Bilotta et al., 2025 ; Frimer et al., 2023 ; Van’t Riet and Van Stekelenburg, 2022 ; Muddiman, 2017 ) . An extension of this logic applies to ideological extremity, which we refer to as wingness ; the farther a party is from the political center, the more policies it disputes. Since ideologically extreme parties dispute policies from more parties than ideologically centered parties, and assuming this disagreement translates into rhetorical attacks, we expect an increase in blame attribution from these more extreme parties ( Elmelund-Præstekær, 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: Bilotta等人, 2025年。 这种二元性在理论上基于道德心理学, 指责可以作为一种信号, 在政治背景下,这种标志性逻辑产生了一个明确的预测,即反对派的行为者,他们反对执政党,最有责备的动机,因为这样做的同时凸显了对手的政策失误并区别了自己的立场。 我们称这为政治对比, 是一种言论策略, 这种逻辑的延伸适用于意识形态极端,我们称之为翼;政党越远离政治中心,它就越会争论政策。 由于意识形态上极端政党的争议政策比意识形态上以政党为中心的政党多,而且假设这种分歧会变成言辞上的攻击,我们期望这些更极端政党的责任归属会增加(Elmelund-Præstekær,2010年)。

blocks.en: 1.2 Emotional Tone in Parliamentary Discourse
blocks.zh: 1.2 议会演讲中的情感通心粉

blocks.en: Cross-national analyses of European parliaments find that negative and neutral sentiment dominate, that positive sentiment is consistently the least frequent category, and that shifts in emotional tone mirror country-specific political conditions rather than reflecting a single universal pattern ( Mochtak et al., 2025 ; Lehtosalo and Nerbonne, 2024 ; Rheault et al., 2016 ) . Research specifically on Danish and Dutch intra-party speeches finds that emotional arousal has increased over time, even as the overall valence of sentiment has remained stable ( Schumacher et al., 2019 ) . This suggests a growing intensity of political language rather than a directional shift – an intensity we expect extends to blame. However, sentiment is not equivalent to blame: a sentence can be negative without attributing responsibility to any actor.
blocks.zh: 欧洲各国议会的跨国分析发现,负面和中性情绪占主导地位,积极情绪始终是最不常见的类别,情绪语气的转变反映了具体国家的政治条件,而不是反映单一的普遍模式(Mochtak等,2025;Lehtosalo和Nerbonne,2024;Rheault等,2016)。 具体关于丹麦和荷兰党内演说的研究发现,情绪激动随着时间推移而增加,即使情绪的总体价值保持稳定(Shumacher等,2019年). 这说明政治语言越来越激烈,而不是方向性转变 — — 我们期望这种强度被归咎于。 然而,情绪并不等同于责备:判刑可以是负面的,而不将责任归咎于任何行为者。

blocks.en: Given the impact of political discourse on the health of democracy, we investigate how blame attribution varies with structural political characteristics and how this relates to contested empirical claims about the recent rise of hostile communication in politics. In order to ensure that the blame identification reflects the rhetorical act itself, rather than prior assumptions about which parties typically blame, this paper follows precedent in the literature that blame can be contained exclusively in linguistic markers Park et al. (2021) ; Liang et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 鉴于政治言论对民主健康的影响,我们调查了责任归属如何因结构性政治特征而异,以及这与关于政治中敌对交流最近抬头的有争议的经验性说法有何关系。 为了确保指责的确定反映言论行为本身,而不是以往通常指责哪些当事方的假设,本文件遵循文献中的先例,可以完全将指责包含在语言标记中。 朴来等 (2021); 梁来等 (2019).

blocks.en: 1.3 Contributions and Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 1.3 捐款和假设

blocks.en: The contributions of this paper are three-fold:
blocks.zh: 本文件的贡献有三:

blocks.en: Firstly, we annotate a dataset of direct utterances from politicians from the Danish parliament (1997-2026) using an annotation-efficient pipeline computationally assisted by the NLI model DEBATE Burnham et al. (2026) and computationally validated using downstream performance on a manually constructed test-set.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们利用NLI模型DEBATE Burnham等人(2026年)协助的注解效率高的管道,对丹麦议会(1997-2026年)政治人物的直接言论数据集进行注释,并在人工构建的测试集上利用下游性能进行计算验证。

blocks.en: Secondly, we publish the first model for blame detection in a Danish political context.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们公布了第一个在丹麦政治背景下查明责任的模式。

blocks.en: Thirdly, we estimate general temporal and political aspects of blame attribution and contrast these results with more recent developments (2019-2026) to quantify the evolution of blame attribution in the Danish Parliament. This analysis is guided by the following hypotheses:
blocks.zh: 第三,我们估计责任归属的一般时间和政治方面,并将这些结果同最近的事态发展(2019-2026年)作对比,以量化丹麦议会责任归属的演变。 这一分析以下列假设为指导:

blocks.en: Hypotheses H1: The rate of blame attribution in Danish Parliament has increased over time — (H1.1) particularly so in recent years (2019–2026). H2: Political extremity and opposition-status ( political contrasting ) increase blame attribution — (H2.1) particularly so in recent years (2019–2026).
blocks.zh: 假设 H1:丹麦议会的责任归属率随时间推移而上升——(H1.1),特别是近年来(2019–2026). H2:政治极端和反对派地位(政治对比)增加责任归属(H2.1),特别是近年来(2019-2026年).

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en: The ParlSpeechV2 dataset covers transcripts from the Danish Parliament from 07/10-1997 to 20/12-2018 and was collected by scraping the Danish Parliaments’ website Rauh and Schwalbach (2020) . We fetched more recent transcripts from the Danish Parliament’s SFTP server. At the time of the fetch, the earliest transcribed debate was from 06/10-2009, and the most recent from 26/02-2026. The datasets were merged from 20/12-2018, which is the last date in ParlSpeechV2, with the next available date from our fetch, 09/01-2019, for a full dataset covering 07/10-1997 to 26/02-2026. Paragraphs spoken by a chairman were excluded. Minimal standardization was required between the sets, but ParlSpeechV2 contains certain metadata that our fetch did not, which was removed. See Appendix A.1 for a consistency check of temporal data characteristics.
blocks.zh: ParlSpeechV2数据集涵盖丹麦议会从1997年10月7日到12月20日-2018年的录音笔录,通过刮去丹麦议会网站Rauh和Schwalbach(2020年)收集. 我们从丹麦议会的SFTP服务器上获得了更多最新记录。 在取地时,最早的转写辩论是自2009年10月06日,最近一次是自2026年02月26日. 数据集于20/12-2018年合并,这是ParlSpeechV2的最后一个日期,下一个可用日期从我们的取来(09/01-2019),用于涵盖07/10-1997至26/02-2026的完整数据集. 主席发言的段落不在此列。 集之间需要最小的标准化,但ParlSpeechV2包含了某些我们获取没有的元数据,这些元数据被删除了. 关于时间数据特征的一致性检查,见附录A.1。

blocks.en: Preprocessing and Labeling: In order to create an annotation-efficient pipeline computationally assisted by DEBATE, two of its architectural properties require upstream preprocessing of the input data. First, being a fine-tuned DeBERTa-V3 based zero-shot classifier ( Laurer et al., 2023 ) , it is not multilingual by design -- necessitating machine translation. Second, input is restricted to 512 tokens, which requires splitting the data into sentences instead of full paragraphs. Sentence segmentation was done using DaCy 2 2 2 Using the ”da_dacy_large_trf” model, version 0.2.0 Enevoldsen et al. (2021) . Sentences shorter than five characters or containing parentheses were excluded, reducing the number of sentences from 6,553,133 to 5,598,994 (85%).
blocks.zh: 预处理和标签: 为了在DEBATE的帮助下建立一个具有注释效率的管道,其两个建筑属性需要上游预处理输入数据. 首先,作为一个经过微调的DeBERTa-V3基于零发分级器(Laurer等,2023年),它不是通过设计 -- -- 需要机器翻译的多语种。 其次,输入限制在512个令牌,这需要将数据分出为句子而不是完整段落. Enevoldsen等人(2021年)使用“da_dacy_group_trf”模式,进行了判决分割。 删去了5个字以下或有括号的刑期,将刑期从6 553 133个减少到5 598 994个(85%)。

blocks.en: 500,500 sentences were then randomly sampled from the cleaned dataset for use in model training, validation, and testing, while the remaining 5,098,494 sentences were held out for inference. Only the training data was machine translated using Opus-MT-da-en Tiedemann et al. (2023) and labeled with DEBATE, done by passing each sentence through a set of hypothesis templates:
blocks.zh: 然后从被清理的数据集中随机抽取500,500个句子,用于模型培训,验证和测试,而其余5,098,494个句子则留作推论. 只有培训数据是使用Opus-MT-da-en Tiedemann等人(2023年)翻译的,并贴有DEBATE标签,通过一套假说模板将每一句句子通过:

blocks.en: T1. Based on this text, the author’s attitude towards others is best described as {}. T2. Overall, the author’s stance toward others in this passage is {}. T3. The overall feeling that the author communicates toward others in this text is best described as {}. T4. According to this passage, the author’s reaction to others’ conduct can be described as {}. T5. From the way others are described, the author’s expression towards them is best described as {}.
blocks.zh: T1. 根据该案文,作者对他人的态度最好被描述为Q.。 T2号 总的来说,提交人在本段中对他人的立场是...。 T3号 作者在本文中向他人传达的总体感觉最好被描述为QQ. T4型车. 根据这段话,作者对他人行为的反应可以被描述为". T5型车. 从描述他人的方式来看,作者对他们的表达最好被描述为Q.

blocks.zh: 总的来说,提交人在本段中对他人的立场是...。

blocks.en: The candidate labels passed to the hypothesis templates were “blame” , “praise” , and “neutral” . The choice of “blame” versus “praise” was based on a general consensus in the literature that these two concepts can be considered antonyms Tognazzini and Coates (2024) ; Williams () . The "neutral" label was added to account for edge cases, such as a high probability of both blame and praise occurring in the same sentence.
blocks.zh: 提交假说模板的候选标签是“指责”、“赞扬”和“中立”。 “指责”和“建议”的选择基于文献中的一项普遍共识,即这两个概念可以被认为是蚁名Tognazzini和Coates(2024);Williams (). "中性"标签被添加到边缘案例中,比如在同一句中同时发生责难和赞美的概率高.

blocks.en: Absolute probabilities for each label were extracted by DEBATE. A threshold for the classification of blame in a sentence was determined as the probability of blame being ≥ .80 \geq.80 and greater than both “praise” and “neutral” . These labels were then mapped back onto the original Danish sentence.
blocks.zh: 每个标签的绝对概率由DEBATE提取出. 在某一句中,对责任进行分类的门槛被确定为:责任概率为 .80\geq.80并大于“建议”和“中立”的概率。 这些标签随后被映射回丹麦语原句.

blocks.en: Training Data: Based on the five hypothesis templates, five separate datasets which we call "Datasets of Increasing Agreement Levels" (DIALs) were constructed. For each DIAL- n , a sentence was given a positive label if at least n templates agreed, ranging from the most conservative, n = 5 \textit{n}=5 (DIAL-5), to the least conservative n = 1 n=1 (DIAL-1). The prevalence of blame was 1.71 % , 1.18 % , 0.91 % , 0.70 % 1.71\%,1.18\%,0.91\%,0.70\% , and 0.50 % 0.50\% for DIAL-1 to DIAL-5, respectively.
blocks.zh: 训练数据:根据五个假说模板,构建了五个单独的数据集,我们称之为"协议水平增加的Datasets"(DIALs). 对每个 DIAL-n ,如果至少同意n 模板,则给出了正标签,从最保守的,n = 5\textit{n}=5 (DIAL-5),到最保守的,n = 1 n = 1 (DIAL-1). 指责率分别为1.71%、1.18%、0.91%、0.70 %、1.71%、1.18 %、0.91 %、0.70 %、0.50 %,分别是DIAL-1至DIAL-5。

blocks.en: Gold Label Test Set: Due to the class imbalance, upsampling of blame was performed by randomly sampling 250 blame and 250 non-blame sentences from DIAL-1, following established practices ( Bigoulaeva et al., 2022 ; Rathpisey and Adji, 2019 ; Anju et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: Gold Label Test Set:由于班级不平衡,通过随机抽样抽取了250个被指责和250个非被指责的句子,从DIAL-1开始,遵循既定做法(Bigoulaeva等,2022;Rathpisey和Adji,2019;Anju等,2024).

blocks.en:
These 500 samples were manually annotated by two of the authors (males, Danish, age 24-25),
who were instructed to follow the definition of Bilotta et al. (2025) of blame as a causal utterance with negative sentiment. For examples of such sentences, see Appendix A.2 .
Inter-annotator agreement was 84.8% (Cohen’s Kappa = .676 .676 ). Only sentences where both annotators agreed were included in the test set, totaling 424 samples (148 blame, 34.9%).
blocks.zh:
这500个样本由两位作者(男性,丹麦语,24-25岁)手动注释,
他们奉命遵循Bilotta等人(2025年)关于指责的定义,认为是消极情绪的因果关系。 这些句子的例子见附录A.2。
公证人之间的协议是84.8%(Cohen的Kappa = 676.676 ) 。 只有两个公证人都同意的句子才被纳入测试组,共有424个样本(148起指责,34.9%)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model Development
blocks.zh: 2.2 模型开发

blocks.en: 20,000 sentences extracted from each DIAL were used for model training. In each subset, true labels were upsampled by including all true labels from each template.
blocks.zh: 从每个DIAL中提取出20 000个句子用于模范培训。 在每个子集中,通过将每个模板中所有真实的标签都包含在内,真实的标签都得到了提升.

blocks.en: The training pipeline was a full precision LoRA fine-tune Hu et al. (2021) with a rank of 64 and alpha scaling at 128 using focal loss. A hyperparameter grid search was performed over the five DIAL subsets, with three learning rates; 1 ​ e − 5 1e^{-5} , 1 ​ e − 4 1e^{-4} , 5 ​ e − 4 5e^{-4} , all with a linear learning rate decay using the Huggingface trainer API Wolf et al. (2020) . Three alpha scaling constants were applied for the focal loss function: raw class weights, class weights to the power of two-thirds, and the square root of class weights. The Gamma focusing parameter was kept constant at 2.0.
blocks.zh: 训练管是完全精准的LORA微调Hu等(2021年),使用焦损失,等级为64等,α缩放为128等. 对5个DIAL子集进行了超参数网格搜索,有3个学习率;1 e − 5 1e → 5},1 e − 4 1e → 4 1e → 4 e → 5e → 4 → 4 5e → 4 → 5 → 4 ),均使用Huggingface训练员Wolf等人(2020年)进行线性学习率衰减. 3个α缩放常数被应用于焦损函数:生类分量重,类分量重到三分之二的功率,和类分量重的平方根. Gamma 聚焦参数不变为 2. 0 。

blocks.en: mmBERT Marone et al. (2025) was trained and validated on an 80-20 split of each DIAL subset, and performance was measured by maximizing the Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) on the validation split.
blocks.zh: 毫米贝特 Marone等人(2025年)就每个DIAL子集分出80~20分,进行了培训和验证,通过在验证分出时将Matthews相干系数(MCC)最大化来测量性能.

blocks.en: Model Performance The model with the highest MCC for each of the DIALs was tested on the gold-labeled test set. Both DIAL-5 and DIAL-4 yielded models with the same macro-F1. However, due to a better trade-off between precision and recall, we chose to use the DIAL-5 model, which was trained with a learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1e^{-4} and an Alpha parameter of the square root of the class weights. This model, called BlameBERT , obtained an average recall score of .81, an average precision score of .80, and an macro-averaged F1 score of .80. For performance metrics across all DIALs, see Appendix A.3 and A.4 . To investigate if errors were party-specific, we examined performance across parties on the test set, see Appendix A.6 . No systematic error rate was found.
blocks.zh: 模型性能 每一个DIAL的MCC最高的模型在金色标记的测试集上进行了测试. DIAL-5和DIAL-4都以相同的宏F1制取出模型. 然而,由于精度和回想之间的更好的取舍,我们选择了使用DIAL-5模式,该模式经过了1e-4 1e-Q-4}的学习速率和班级权重平方根的阿尔法参数的训练. 这个名为"BlameBERT"的模型获得了平均回想分.81分,平均精确分.80分,宏观平均分.80分. 关于所有对话阶段的业绩衡量标准,见附录A.3和A.4。 为了调查错误是否因当事方而异,我们在测试集中检查了各缔约方的业绩,见附录A.6。 没有找到系统错误率 。

blocks.en: Model Comparison: A baseline for zero-shot blame classification was established using the Qwen 3:0.6B embedding model Zhang et al. (2025) and the generative Qwen 3.5:9B Qwen Team (2026) . The results of this classification are shown in Table 1 .

blocks.en: Based on these results, we argue that BlameBERT is best suited to the task, even before taking into account the computational cost of the generative Qwen model. More details about computation of baselines can be found in Appendix A.5 .

blocks.en: Preprocessing: Only parties that still existed and actively practiced politics within continental Denmark at the time of the analysis were included. Additionally, all utterances from non-attached members of parliament were excluded, reducing the number of unique sentences to 4,938,119 (96.9%). The final 13 parties are noted in Table 2 along with their political wing and degree of wingness .
blocks.zh: 预处理 : 在分析时,只有丹麦大陆内仍然存在并积极从事政治活动的政党才包括在内。 此外,不附庸议员的言论均被排除在外,将独有的刑期减至4 938 119人(96.9%)。 最后13个政党及其政治派别和派别程度见表2。

blocks.en: Wing is defined based on the general ideological placement of the parties from the Chapel Hill Expert Survey Rovny et al. (2025) . Parties with positive standardized scores are placed on the right wing, while parties with negative scores are placed on the left wing. The zero threshold reflects the sample mean of the standardized ideology index. Wingness is defined as the absolute standardized distance from the mean. See Appendix A.7 for the calculation.
blocks.zh: "翼"的定义取自"礼拜山专家调查·罗夫尼等"(2025年)中各方的一般思想定位. 有正向标准分数的政党被放入右翼,有负向分数的政党被放入左翼. 零阈值反映了标准化意识形态指数的样本平均值. 翼相被定义为绝对的标准化距离正中. 有关计算,见附录A.7。

blocks.en: All remaining sentences were classified using blameERT, and aggregated by month, year, and party, resulting in each row of a dataset containing a month-wise count of total sentences and sentences containing blame for each party. The resulting dataset contained a total of 2,529 observations. For recent years (2019-2026), the number of observations was 810.

blocks.en: Sensitivity and Political Agenda: The blame labels produced by BlameBERT carry classification uncertainty that is not accounted for in the statistical models, potentially reducing statistical power and obscuring true effect sizes. Inspection of BlameBERT performance indicated that the model overpredicts blame (Table 1 ). However, if overprediction is balanced across all focal predictors, the relative effect of political characteristics will still hold. To inspect the robustness of results, a sensitivity analysis was conducted by applying increasingly conservative probability thresholds. For full analysis, see Appendix A.9
blocks.zh: 敏感性和政治议程: BlameBERT公司生产的指责标签带有统计模型中没有说明的分类不确定性,有可能降低统计力量并模糊真实效果大小. 对BlameBERT业绩的检查表明,模型过度预测了责任(表1)。 然而,如果在所有重点预测者中平衡过度预测,政治特征的相对影响仍将存在。 为了检查结果的稳健性,采用了越来越保守的概率阈值,进行了敏感性分析。 全面分析见附录A.9。

blocks.en: Additionally, the models did not control for the topic or agenda of the parliamentary proceedings, which can affect sentiment and emotional language in political settings Pätz et al. (2025) ; Ristilä et al. (2026) . Government status of Danish parties has also been found to differ topically in their speeches ( Navarretta and Haltrup Hansen, 2024 ) . A minimalistic analysis was implemented using ManifestoBERTa Burst et al. (2024) to classify political topics on a sentence level, and investigate if parties in government and in opposition generally differed in their agenda, and if controlling for such topics alters the effect of government status on blame attribution. For full analysis, see Appendix A.10
blocks.zh: 此外,这些模式无法控制议会程序的主题或议程,这可能影响Pätz等人(2025年);Ristilä等人(2026年)的政治环境中的情绪和情感语言。 丹麦政党的政府地位也被认为在演讲中存在专题差异(Navarretta和Haldrup Hansen,2024年)。 利用《宣言》进行了最低限度的分析 BERTa Burst等人(2024年)将政治议题分类到句子层面,并调查政府和反对党的议程是否普遍不同,对这些议题的控制是否改变了政府地位对责任归属的影响. 全面分析见附录A.10。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Blame Attribution: Examining the effect of time on blame attribution (H1) revealed a banana-shaped effect throughout the 29-year period, suggesting that blame rhetoric initially declined – reaching a global minimum in ∼ \sim April 2016 – then increased at an accelerating rate (Fig. 2 , left). This pattern is consistent with the public belief of an increasingly harsh political scene. The timing coincides with Denmark’s 2015 immigration crisis, after which rhetoric toward immigrants reportedly hardened across the political spectrum, even among parties not typically associated with conservative immigration views Navarretta et al. (2022) . A significant positive linear trend was also found in recent years (H1.1), mirroring the overall-period increase in Analysis H1 (Fig. 2 , right).
blocks.zh: 责怪归属: 检视时间对责任归属的影响(H1)揭示出整个29年间香蕉状的影响, 暗示指责言论起初会减少, 这一模式符合公众对日益严峻的政治局面的信念。 丹麦在2015年的移民危机中, 对移民的言辞在政治各行各业, 甚至是与保守移民观点无关的政党(2022年)。 近年来还发现一个显著的正线性趋势(H1.1),反映了分析H1(图2,右)中整个期间的增长.

blocks.en:
Political Contrasting : 
Analysis of structural political characteristics and their relationship with blame (H2) showed that government status had a substantial blame-dampening effect, with governing left-wing parties only blaming ∼ 62 % \sim 62\% compared to left-wing opposition parties – a finding consistent with the idea of political contrasting . This blame-dampening effect was ∼ 11 % \sim 11\% weaker among right-wing parties (Fig. 3 , left). The main effects of wing affiliation and wingness were not significant. Given the interactions, these reflect the difference between wings for opposition parties at zero wingness and the effect of wingness among left-wing parties, respectively. The significant interactions thus underline that the effects of ideology are not absent, but differentiated across political affiliation.
blocks.zh:
政治矛盾:
对结构政治特征及其与指责的关系(H2)的分析表明,政府地位具有巨大的指责掩盖作用,对左翼政党的治理只指责了左翼政党的62%\sim 62\}而左翼反对党的这一结果与政治对比的观点是一致的。 在右翼政党中,这种责难消除的效果是--11%\sim 11\\\%弱(图3,左)。 机翼隶属和机翼性的主要效果并不显著. 鉴于这些互动关系,它们分别反映了反对派零翼的翼与左翼政党的翼效应之间的差异. 因此,重要的互动突出表明,意识形态的影响并非不存在,而是因政治派别而异。

blocks.en: The effect of wingness also differed across opposing beliefs. The increase in blame was stronger for the right wing, with each one unit increase resulting in a ∼ 74 % \sim 74\% increase in blame attribution compared to parties on the left wing (Fig. 4 , left). These findings partially support those of Elmelund-Præstekær (2010) , as more ideologically extreme parties seem to be associated with an increase in blame. However, our findings only support this effect being true for right-wing parties. The blame dampening effect of government held in recent years (H2.1), where government status remained a significant negative predictor of blame, with governing parties blaming only 60 % 60\% compared to the opposition. As the interaction between government status and wing did not improve model fit in this period, this effect applies across both wings (Fig. 3 , right).
blocks.zh: 不同信仰的翼性效果也不同. 与左翼政党(图4,左翼)相比,对右翼的指责增加得更强烈,每个单位的指责增加导致74%\sim 74%的指责归属增加. 这些结论部分支持了Elmelund-Præstekær(2010年)的结论,因为意识形态上更极端的政党似乎与责任增加有关。 然而,我们的调查结果只支持这种对右翼政党的影响。 政府的地位仍然是主要负面的指责预测者, 执政党对反对派的指责只有60%。 由于政府地位和翼间的互动没有改善适合这一时期的模式,这种效果适用于两翼(图3,右).

blocks.en: In contrast, the main effect of ideological wing affiliation was significant in this period, with right-wing parties attributing less blame than left-wing parties (Fig. 3 , right). However, given the interaction with wingness , this effect is estimated at wingness being zero, and thus reflects the estimated difference between wings at the arbitrary state of all parties being politically placed at the center, see low wingness on the right-hand side of Figure 4 . As such, the results indicate that when computing wing differences across the mean value of wingness , which is more representative of the actual parties associated with each wing, left-wing parties show substantially reduced blame attribution compared to right-wing parties, see right side of Figure 3 . The main effect of wingness , reflecting its effect among left-wing parties, was not significant, indicating no systematic relationship between blame and ideological extremity on the left. However, the interaction between ideological wing and wingness was again significant, showing the same trend as for the entire period, where parties on the right show a substantially greater positive relationship between their degree of wingness and increase in blame attribution (Fig. 4 , right). Crucially, this effect was intensified, with each unit increase in wingness resulting in a 126 % 126\% increase in blame attribution among right-wing parties compared to left-wing parties.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,意识形态从属关系在这一时期的主要影响是显著的,右翼政党的责任比左翼政党(图3,右翼)要小. 然而,考虑到与翼的相互作用,这种效应估计为翼为零,因此反映了在各方被政治置于中央的任意状态下,翅膀之间的估计差异,见图4右侧的低翼. 因此,结果表明,当计算机翼在机翼平均值上的差异(它更能代表与机翼有关的实际政党)时,左翼政党显示,与右翼政党相比,责任归属大大减少,见图3右侧。 在左翼政党中,翼性的主要作用并不显著,表明指责和左翼意识形态极端之间没有系统的关系。 然而,意识形态翼与翼之间的相互作用再次具有重大意义,显示出与整个期间相同的趋势,即右翼政党在翼与责怪归属增加之间有明显更大的积极关系(图4,右)。 关键的是,这种效应被强化了,每个单位的翼分增加,导致与左翼政党相比,右翼政党的责任归属增加了126%.

blocks.en: Collectively, these findings describe a parliament in which blame is not only rising but is increasingly structured by ideology, intensifying most among ideologically extreme right-wing parties. As the findings of Hinterleitner (2020) also underline, these ideologically extreme right wing parties could potentially be pulling moderate parties toward more blame generation in order not to be overshadowed in the debates. This dynamic of blame becoming a more frequent occurrence within politics could spread, as parliamentary debate is at the core of democratic institutions: The rhetoric exchanged here helps set the stage for how political conflict is handled throughout society, and such an asymmetric hardening may therefore carry consequences that extend beyond the chamber itself.
blocks.zh: 集体而言,这些调查结果描述了一个议会,其责任不仅在增加,而且日益由意识形态构成,在意识形态极端的右翼政党中最为强化。 正如Hinterleitner(2020年)的结论也强调的那样,这些意识形态极端的右翼政党可能会将温和的政党推向更多的指责,以免在辩论中蒙上阴影。 由于议会辩论是民主机构的核心,这种指责在政治中更加频繁地发生: 这里交流的言论有助于为整个社会如何处理政治冲突打下基础,因此,这种不对称的强硬可能带来超出会议厅本身的后果。

blocks.en: Sensitivity and Political Topic: The sensitivity analysis showed strong robustness, as the direction and significance of findings hold at all thresholds, with the interaction effect between government status and ideological wing in Analysis H2 being the one exception. This effect was the same direction, but not statistically significant at the most conservative threshold, see appendix A.9 . The sensitivity analysis underlines the robustness of the relative effects, while acknowledging that blame is a difficult construct to identify – a point corroborated by the Cohen’s Kappa of .676 on the test set, and the many different definitions of blame in the literature ( Portmore, 2022 ; Malle et al., 2014 ; Tognazzini and Coates, 2024 ; Susan et al., 2011 ; Bilotta et al., 2025 ; Shoemaker and Vargas, 2021b ; Shoemaker, 2015 ; Wallace, 2011 ; Smith, 2012 ; Malle et al., 2013 ; Wang, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 敏感性和政治议题: 敏感度分析显示出强烈的强烈性,因为结论的方向和意义在所有阈值上都有所影响,而H2分析中政府地位和意识形态派别之间的相互作用效应是一个例外。 这一影响是同一个方向,但在最保守的临界点统计上并不重要,见附录A.9。 敏感度分析强调了相对效应的强烈性,同时承认指责是一个难以确定的构思 — — 科恩的"卡普帕"在测试集上证实了6.76的点,以及文献中对指责的许多不同定义(Portmore,2022;Malle等,2014;Tognazzini和Coates,2024;Susan等,2011;Bilotta等,2025;Shoemake和Vargas,2021b;Shoemake,2015;Wallace,2011;Smith,2012;Malle等,2013;Wang,2024).

blocks.en: Governing and opposition parties did not notably differ in their topical agendas, and controlling for topic did not alter the blame-dampening effect of government status. For the full analysis, see Appendix A.10 .
blocks.zh: 执政党和反对党在议题议程上没有明显差异,对议题的控制并没有改变政府地位的责任分散效应。 全面分析见附录A.10。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study examined blame attribution in the Danish Parliament from 1997 to 2026, combining a purpose-built classifier with multilevel statistical modeling across nearly five million parliamentary sentences. Our results reveal a banana-shaped temporal trajectory of blame declining through 2016 before entering a sustained and accelerating increase in recent years, a trend corroborated by a standalone analysis of the temporal drift in blame from 2019 to 2026. Government status consistently suppresses blame attribution across both periods, consistent with political contrasting . Throughout the full period, this effect is moderated by ideological wing affiliation, with right-wing parties showing a weaker reduction in blame when in government and a stronger amplification of blame as wingness increases. In the more recent period, the government effect applied across both wings, while the interaction between wing and wingness intensified compared to the full period. A sensitivity analysis on the classification threshold confirmed that the direction and significance of the core findings are robust across thresholds. Taken together, these findings offer partial empirical support for the perceived rise in political harshness in Denmark, while underlining that this shift is nonuniform across the Danish political landscape.
blocks.zh: 这项研究研究了1997年至2026年丹麦议会的责任归属,将一个专门设计的分类器与针对近500万个议会判决的多层次统计模型结合起来。 我们的结果显示,直到2016年,香蕉状的时间性责任轨迹不断下降,近年来进入持续和加速的增长,对2019至2026年的时间性责任漂移进行的独立分析证实了这一趋势。 政府地位始终压制两个时期的责任归属,这与政治对比是一致的。 在整个期间,这种影响因意识形态派别的从属关系而减缓,右翼政党在政府中的责任减少较弱,而随着派系势力的扩大,责任扩大的程度也更大。 在更近的一段时间里,政府效应适用于两翼,而与整个时期相比,两翼和翼之间的相互作用也有所加强. 对分类阈值的敏感性分析证实,核心结论的方向和意义跨越阈值。 综合起来,这些调查结果为丹麦政治严酷程度的明显上升提供了部分经验性支持,同时强调这种转变在丹麦政治格局中并不统一。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Measurement limitations: Our blame labels rest on a multi-step pipeline with each step potentially introducing noise. Training labels were generated by machine-translating Danish sentences into English before applying DEBATE. This was a necessary step given the architectural constraints of DEBATE, but the translation model may distort the signal DEBATE itself responds to, consequently propagating this into the training data. Furthermore, translation artifacts might be particularly pronounced for ironic, rhetorically indirect phrasing, or language specific idioms. DEBATE itself was primarily developed and validated on English political text, and translation from Danish political text to English might not fully encapsulate rhetorical language-specific differences. As BlameBERT is trained on these silver labels, systematic biases in DEBATE’s zero-shot classifications could be inherited rather than corrected by the fine-tuned model.
blocks.zh: 计量限制: 我们的指责在于一个多步骤的管道,每一步骤都有可能引起噪音。 培训标签是通过在应用DEBATE之前将丹麦语的句子翻译成英语而生成的。 鉴于DEBATE的建筑限制,这是必要的一步,但翻译模型可能扭曲DEBATE本身对信号的反应,从而将信号传播到培训数据中。 此外,翻译文物可能特别用于讽刺性、间接的用词或具体语言的用词。 DEBATE本身主要是在英文政治文本上得到发展和验证的,从丹麦政治文本到英文的翻译可能不能完全包罗语言上的修辞差异。 由于BlameBERT接受过这些银色标签的培训,DEBATE零发分级的系统偏差可以继承而不是被微调模型所纠正.

blocks.en: Modeling limitations: The predictors covering wing affiliation and wingness are time-invariant characteristics that vary across only 13 parties, resulting in limited between-party variance. Although the random intercept permits their inclusion, the effective sample size for these estimates is closer to 13 than to the full observation count, and standard errors should be interpreted accordingly. Relatedly, wing and wingness are both derived from the same underlying "lrgen" measure from the Chapel Hill Expert Survey ( Rovny et al., 2025 ) . Although we treat them as capturing distinct (i.e. categorical versus continuous) aspects of ideological position, some information leakage between them is unavoidable, and should be kept in mind when interpreting their independent contributions. A mild zero-deflation was also detected across all models, as the negative binomial family allocates more probability mass to zero counts than observed in the data. Given its negligible scale and the otherwise well-specified dispersion structure, this is unlikely to materially affect substantive conclusions.
blocks.zh: 建模限制: 涵盖机翼从属关系和机翼的预测器是时间变化性特征,仅在13个党派之间有所不同,导致党与党之间的差异有限. 虽然随机截取可以将其包含在内,但这些估计的有效样本尺寸比完整的观察计数更接近于13个,标准错误应作相应的解释. 与此相关的是,机翼和机翼均取自礼拜山专家调查(Rovny等,2025年)中同一基础"lrgen"度量. 虽然我们把它们视为捕捉意识形态立场的不同(即绝对或持续)方面,但它们之间的一些信息泄漏是不可避免的,在解释它们的独立贡献时应当铭记这一点。 在所有模型中也检测出轻微的零衰减,因为负二元家族将比数据中观察到的更概率质量分配为零计数. 鉴于其可忽略不计的规模和具体分散结构,这不大可能对实质性结论产生实质性影响。

blocks.en: Support parties: Due to the tradition of minority governments in Denmark, parties outside government often act as formal support parties, and are therefore not strictly in opposition, although our binary government indicator treats them as such. Since such arrangements are typically formed within the same political wing, with the notable exception of the cross-wing government formed in 2022, the inclusion of wing affiliation and its interaction with government status partially accounts for this.
blocks.zh: 支助方: 由于丹麦少数民族政府的传统,政府外的政党往往充当正式的支持政党,因此并不严格反对,尽管我们的二进制政府指标却如此对待他们. 由于这种安排通常是在同一个政治派别内形成的,除了2022年组建的跨翼政府这一显著例外,因此把派系的归属及其与政府地位的互动部分地纳入其中。

blocks.en: Scope limitations: The models estimated for the recent period (2019-2026) draw on a smaller sample and span a period marked by considerable political disruption. This includes the COVID-19 pandemic and multiple government transitions, each of which could confound the observed temporal and political trends independent of any genuine shift in rhetorical norms. Our classifier also identifies that blame occurs, but not whom it targets. A party could register high blame-rates while primarily directing blame at external or non-partisan targets like the EU, the pandemic, or global markets, rather than domestic political rivals. This is a meaningfully different phenomenon from the rival-directed political contrasting that our theoretical framework emphasizes.
blocks.zh: 范围限制: 近期(2019-2026年)估计的模型取自较小的样本,跨越了一个具有相当程度政治干扰的时期. 这包括COVID-19大流行病和多重政府过渡,其中每一个都可能混淆所观察到的时间和政治趋势,而不受口头规范的真正变化的影响。 我们的分类人员还查明了责任的发生,但没有查明它针对谁。 一个政党可以记录出高的指责率,而主要指责外部或无党派目标,如欧盟、大流行或全球市场,而不是国内政治对手。 这与我们理论框架所强调、由对手指导的政治对比是一个有意义的不同现象。

blocks.en: Qwen 3-Embedding : The method chosen for the embedding strategy was to use representative “anchor” sentences Zhuo et al. (2024) . blocks.en: Qwen 3.5 Generative : As the Qwen 3.5 model is generative, it was constrained with the Ollama package to output into a structured json schema. This was combined with a temperature of 0 for more deterministic output. Even with this framework, there is no guarantee of a valid response, as the model sometimes breaks down. For this reason, the model was allowed one extra try for each sentence. Otherwise, it was skipped. This null output can be interpreted in three ways: The first option is to treat it as a “true” null by not counting it in model performance and acknowledging failure. The second option is to treat a null as a false, or no blame, label (default no blame). The third option is to treat it as a true, or blame, label (default blame).
blocks.zh: Quen 3.5 遗传: 由于"Quen 3.5"模型具有基因性,因此被奥拉马包所限制,输出成结构化的json schema. 这与温度为0的温度相结合,用于确定更多的产出。 即使有了这一框架,也无法保证作出有效的反应,因为模型有时会崩溃. 为此,该模型被允许为每句增加一次尝试. 否则,它被跳过。 这种无效输出可有三种解释方式: 第一种选择是,不将其计入模型性能中,并承认失败,将其作为“真实的”无效。 第二种选择是把一无是处当作虚假的,或者没有责备的标签(默认无责). 第三个选择是把它当作一个真实的,或者指责的标签(默认的指责).

blocks.en: Another thing to keep in mind when considering using a generative LLM is the computational cost. Inference with Qwen 3.5 on the small dataset in this paper took ∼ 19 \sim 19 hours on an RTX 4070 Super. Inference using BlameBERT, once fine-tuned for ∼ 20 \sim 20 minutes, took a few minutes on an Nvidia L40 GPU. While these are far apart in computational power (L40 being significantly faster), and therefore not directly comparable, BlameBERT is only 307 million parameters, and the version of Qwen 3.5 used here is 9 billion.
blocks.zh: 另一个在考虑使用基因LLM时要记住的是计算成本. 本文中小数据集上与Quen 3.5的推论在RTX 4070 Super上花费了 \\ sim 19小时. 使用BlameBERT的推论,曾经微调了 20\sim 20分钟,在Nvidia L40 GPU上用了几分钟. 虽然这些在计算功率上相去甚远(L40明显快),因此无法直接比较,但BlameBERT只有3.07亿个参数,这里使用的Quen 3.5版本为90亿.

blocks.en: Sentence embeddings provide a simple, cheap, and easy to implement alternative to the other models. The anchor strategy performs reasonably well and is quite balanced between precision and recall.

blocks.en: Collating these findings, the metrics point toward BlameBERT as the best option for blame classification in a political context.

A.10 Controlling for Political Topics
blocks.zh: A.10 控制政治话题

blocks.en: The temporal and political predictors of blame examined in the main analyses do not account for the topical content of parliamentary speech, even though some subjects plausibly invite sharper rhetoric than others. If governing and opposition parties also differ systematically in which topics they speak about, the government-status effect reported in Analysis H2 (M2.5) and Analysis H2.1 (M4.4) could partly reflect agenda composition rather than a genuine difference in rhetorical framing. We therefore conduct a supplementary analysis to assess whether the blame-suppressing effect of government status survives the inclusion of topic as a covariate.
blocks.zh: 主要分析中审查的指责的时间和政治预测因素没有说明议会言论的热门内容,尽管某些主题显然比其他主题更能引起尖锐的言论。 如果执政党和反对党在谈论哪些议题时也存在系统性差异,分析H2(M2.5)和分析H2.1(M4.4)中所报告的政府-地位效应可以部分反映议程构成,而不是在措辞框架上的真正差异。 因此,我们进行一项补充分析,以评估政府地位的责难效应是否在将专题列为共同变量之后继续存在。

blocks.en: Data Preparation: Because the inference data used throughout the paper can contain multiple sentences from the same speaker on the same day, applying a topic classifier to every sentence would yield a set of observations with strong within-speaker-day dependence. To obtain a set of approximately independent observations for this supplementary check, one sentence was randomly sampled for each unique speaker-day combination, yielding a reduced dataset of 84,581 observations.
blocks.zh: 数据准备: 由于整个论文中使用的推断数据可以包含同一天同名演讲者的多句,因此对每一句应用一个话题分类器将产生一套具有强烈的日内依赖性的观察. 为了获得一套大致独立的观察结果来进行这一补充检查,对每个独特的演讲日组合随机抽取了一句话,从而减少了84 581个观察结果。

blocks.en: To assign topics, the classifier manifesto-project/manifestoberta-xlm-roberta-56policy-topics-sentence-2024-1-1 ( Burst et al., 2024 ) was applied to each sampled sentence. This model is a fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa-large classifier trained on 38 languages, including Danish, that assigns text to one of 56 fine-grained political topics. Following the guidelines of the Manifesto-project handbook ( Burst et al., 2024 ) , the 56 topics were collapsed into seven broader domains: External Relations, Freedom and Democracy, Political System, Economy, Welfare and Quality of Life, Fabric of Society, and Social Groups.
blocks.zh: 为指定专题,对每个抽样句子适用了分类宣言-项目/manifestoberta-xlm-roberta-56政策-专题-2024-1-1(Burst等,2024年)。 这个模式是一个精细的XLM-ROBERTa大分级器,训练了38种语言,包括丹麦语,将文字分配给了56个精细的政治话题之一. 根据《宣言-项目手册》(Burst等,2024年)的准则,56个专题被分为七个更广泛的领域:对外关系、自由和民主、政治制度、经济、福利和生活质量、社会结构和社会团体。

blocks.en: Topic and Blame Rate: We first examined whether blame rate varies by topic domain, and whether governing and opposition parties differ in the topics they discuss. Both checks are descriptive and intended to contextualize the subsequent regression analysis rather than serve as statistical tests in themselves.
blocks.zh: 主题和责任率: 我们首先审查责任率是否因主题领域而异,治理党派和反对党讨论的议题是否不同。 这两种检查都是描述性的,旨在将随后的回归分析的背景化,而不是作为统计测试本身。

blocks.en: The proportion of blame-labeled sentences varied substantially across domains. The rate of blame in Fabric of Society was more than three times that observed in Economy, see Figure 12 . This indicates that topic is plausibly related to emotional tone, consistent with the intuition that some subjects invite harsher language than others.
blocks.zh: 指责的句子的比例在各领域内差别很大。 社会结构中的指责率是经济中观察到的三倍多,见图12。 这表明,主题与情感语气有着合理的关联,这与一些学科比其他学科更会吸引更严厉的语言的直觉是一致的.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Proportion of sentences labeled as blame, by political topic domain.
blocks.zh: 图 12: 按政治主题领域划分的被指责的判刑比例。

blocks.en: In contrast, the distribution of topics discussed by governing parties closely resembled that of opposition parties, see Figure 13 . While substantial differences existed in how much attention each topic domain received overall, this allocation did not differ meaningfully by government status. This is consistent with the structure of parliamentary debate, where the agenda for a given proceeding is generally fixed in advance and applies symmetrically to all speakers.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,执政党所讨论议题的分布与反对党相似,见图13。 虽然在对每个专题领域的总体重视程度方面存在着重大差异,但这种分配在政府地位方面并没有有意义的差异。 这符合议会辩论的结构,即某一程序的议程一般事先确定,并对所有发言者对称适用。

blocks.zh: 图13:政府和反对党的专题领域分布。

blocks.en: Taken together, these patterns suggest that although some topic domains are associated with elevated or reduced blame rate, governing and opposition parties are not differentially exposed to high- versus low-blame topics. This makes it unlikely that the government-status effect found in the main analyses is purely an artifact of agenda composition, a possibility we test directly below.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这些模式表明,虽然有些主题领域与高或低的指责率有关,但执政党和反对党并没有因高而低的指责而不同。 这使得在主要分析中发现的政府-地位效应不太可能纯粹是议程构成的一件花花公子,我们在下面直接检验这种可能性。

Critically, the coefficient for government status was nearly unchanged after including topic domain. M1 estimates that a sentence spoken by a governing party has a 67.5 % 67.5\% relative probability of containing blame compared to an opposition party. The corresponding estimate from M2 is 66.3 % 66.3\% . This near-identical estimate indicates that controlling for topical agenda does not meaningfully alter the suppressive effect of government status on blame attribution.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,政府地位的系数在包括主题领域之后几乎保持不变。 M1估计,执政党的判刑与反对党相比,有67.5%的相对概率受到指责。 M2的相应估计值为66.3% 66.3\%. 这一几乎相同的估计表明,对专题议程的控制并不能切实地改变政府地位对责任归属的抑制作用。

blocks.en: Interpretation: The descriptive and model-based results converge on the same conclusion. While topic domain is itself associated with blame rate, and some domains are considerably more conducive to blame than others, governing and opposition parties are not differentially exposed to these domains, and accounting for topic does not erode the government-status effect. This supports the interpretation that the political-contrasting effect identified in Analyses H2 and H2.1 reflects a genuine difference in rhetorical framing between governing and opposition parties, rather than an artifact of which subjects each side happens to discuss more.
blocks.zh: 口译: 基于模型的描述性结果也得出同样的结论。 虽然主题领域本身与指责率有关,有些领域比其他领域更有利于指责,但执政党和反对党没有受到这些领域的不同影响,对主题的考虑不会削弱政府地位的影响。 这支持一种解释,即分析H2和H2.1中确定的政治争议效应反映了执政党和反对党在言论框架上的真正差异,而不是各方碰巧讨论更多问题的一件文物。
